Machu Picchu circuits: essential information

Visit Machu Picchu It involves more than just entering the citadel: currently you must choose a specific circuit that will define your route, the views you will have and the sectors you will be able to visit.

Access is organized through official routes to protect the archaeological site and improve the visitor experience.

Types of circuits in Machu Picchu

Today there are 3 main circuits, each one with a different experience:

Circuit 1 (Panoramic) – Ideal for photos

Classic view of Machu Picchu from the top
Short and visual tour
Does not include many archaeological zones

This is the most used circuit for the typical postcard photo.

Circuit 2 (Classic) – The most complete

⭐ The most recommended for most travelers
Includes temples and main structures
Combine walking + exploration
Allows classic photo

It is the best option if you visit Machu Picchu for the first time.

Circuit 3 (Lower part) – Base for mountain routes

Tour of the lower area of the citadel
More archaeological approach

Important: This circuit serves as a base to access additional routes such as:

  • Huayna Picchu
  • Machu Picchu Mountain
  • Huchuy Picchu

Why is it important to choose the right circuit?

You cannot change circuits once inside
Not all include the classic photo
⏱ Visiting time is limited
Each circuit covers different areas

Tip: If you are not sure, choose the Circuit 2, is the most balanced.

Video information about the circuits

Before booking, we recommend you see this updated explanation:

https://www.facebook.com/reel/1940971926526227

Which circuit to choose according to your type of trip?

Family trip → Circuit 1 or 2
Backpackers → Circuit 2
Photography → Circuit 1
Adventure (mountains) → Circuit 3 + additional entrance

Recommendations before buying your ticket

Check availability in advance
Buy official or agency tickets
Choose your check-in time carefully
Find out what each circuit includes

Can you tour Machu Picchu freely?

Not completely
The route is controlled by circuits
You must follow the assigned route

Planning well is key to not miss out on the best.
